dateOrder: Production date must not be after expiry date.
unknownCostHint: Stock is recorded. Profit is not calculated until a cost is entered. Unknown cost is not zero.
factorHistory: This receipt’s conversion factor is kept in its history.
newProductHint: Use “Add product” to register a new product first.
supplierHint: Enter the supplier name in the search field.
resultIncomplete: Unable to show the complete result. Reload for updated information; do not submit again.
confirmDifferentInvoice: This is a different invoice; submit it
allocateOnSubmit: Updated amounts are saved and allocated across items on submission.

submitDuplicate: Submit with a duplicate invoice number

discardHint: The receipt items will be deleted. Stock will not change.
emptyHint: Supplier purchases and opening stock appear here.

receipt.missingProduct: No product of this store has barcode {code}.
receipt.ambiguousBarcode: Several products share barcode {code}; choose one by search.

receipt.charges: Charges and discount of this purchase
receipt.sideChargeHint: Kept apart from tax and spread over the product cost.
receipt.chargesNeedCost: Charges are spread over the product cost; enter a cost or leave the charges empty.

receipt.salePriceHint: Current price: {price}. Recording a purchase never changes the sale price by itself.
receipt.salePriceNone: This product has no sale price yet. Recording a purchase does not set one by itself.

continuous.chooseFirst: Choose the product by barcode or search first.
